rules.title: System crash and hang reports
rules.summary: Crash, hang and resource reports of system processes, older than 30 days.
rules.recovery: Not rebuilt; only old reports are lost. New reports are written when a process fails.

rules.title: Rotated system logs
rules.summary: Compressed old parts of system logs, older than 7 days.
rules.recovery: Not rebuilt; the current logs stay. macOS rotates logs again on its own.

rules.title: Old logs of installers and services
rules.summary: Log files of installers and system services in /Library/Logs, older than 30 days.
rules.recovery: Not rebuilt; only old logs are lost. A log that is in use was written recently, so it stays.

rules.title: Unified log of macOS
rules.summary: The log store that Console and the log command read: messages of all processes since the last erase.
rules.recovery: Not rebuilt. After the erase, Console and log show no messages from before. macOS writes new messages at once.
